notes.title: Patch Update V0.3.1.1
notes.content:
As we eagerly work on our upcoming substantial update, we recognize the importance of ensuring a seamless gaming experience for our community. In the meantime, we've prepared a minor patch to tackle some issues reported since our last update. This hotfix is designed to enhance the overall stability and address specific concerns, providing you with a smoother gaming experience as we gear up for the release of our next major update. Thank you for your continued support and patience!

With that in mind, here is the comprehensive list of modifications included in this update:

[h2]GAMEPLAY & BALANCE CHANGES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 'Horus Vision' feature to see enemies through the walls.
[*] Trap placement feature became smoother.
[*] Tweaked the damage balance of Purple Bullets.
[*] Adjusted Wadjet's death counting for increased coin rewards.
[*] Updated all enemies' attacking barricade logic.
[*] Enabled teleportation for all stairs.
[*] Modified Flip Trap dynamics to prevent excessive throwing of characters.
[*] Slowed down Scarab by 25% and increased Thoth's speed by 50%.
[*] Implemented raycast check for Thoth to prevent shooting through walls.
[*] Increased lava trap cooldown.
[/list]

[h2]QUALITY OF LIFE:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Pause Menu now automatically closes upon pressing any button within it.
[*] During wave countdown, both the Pause Menu and Trap Menu are deactivated for 3 seconds.
[*] Upon completing a level, various actions such as movement, rotation, teleportation, shooting, and menu functionalities are now deactivated for a smoother transition.
[*] Aligned UI elements for a centralized display.
[*] Improved UI warnings for trap placement and insufficient coins.
[*] Updated LevelLoader function for smoother level transitions.
[*] Updated the controller image at the lobby.
[*] Level descriptions now display the names of each level.
[*] Checked and confirmed proper functionality of graphics and sound settings.
[*] Disabled trap buttons on the menu when the player's total coin is insufficient.
[*] Implemented a warning UI when Wadjet spawns to alert players of an incoming boss.
[/list]

[h2]ISSUE & BUG FIXES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where setting buttons were not functioning as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where all levels experienced an unintended progression reset.
[*] Fixed a gap problem in Level-2's stairs and Level-3's monkey pyramid.
[*] Fixed the issues of the Pause Menu buttons.
[*] Fixed Wadjet's death not counting bug.
[*] Fixed an issue where a trap could be placed inside the statue in Level-3.
[/list]


We extend our sincere gratitude for your unwavering support and valuable feedback. As we continue to evolve the game, your insights remain crucial. If you encounter any challenges or have suggestions, please reach out—there's more excitement and improvements on the horizon. Your journey with us is far from over, and we eagerly look forward to sharing more adventures in future updates. Until then, happy gaming, and anticipate more to come!

🔗 Connect with us beyond the game! Join our community on Discord and be part of the conversation. Share your feedback, discuss strategies, and stay updated on the latest happenings!

🌐 [b]Discord Server:[/b] https://discord.gg/5pCchjdmjs


Horizon of Horus, Developer Team
